_schema: tropoi.run.airless.config.AirlessConfig (commit d11afe82a5490f4344bd67c2a3e12c2230a16d3f); field layout follows config.json as written by AirlessRun

strata.name: Ceres fine regolith, constant properties (TI = 15 J m^-2 K^-1 s^-1/2)
strata.source: INFERRED: k = TI^2 / (rho c_p) with TI 15 (Rognini et al. 2020, JGR Planets 125, e2019JE006308: bulk surface 1-15 to 50-60); rho 1300 and c_p 750 ASSUMED (dry fine regolith, Mercury/lunar analogue values)

provenance.orbit: MEASURED: a = 2.7653 au, e = 0.0791, JPL SSD small-body element table (epoch MJD 55400); period 1.451194e8 s (1679.6 d) from Kepler III with the IAU 2015 B3 nominal GM_sun 1.3271244e20 m^3 s^-2 (same convention as the Mercury presets); epoch t = 0 at perihelion
provenance.irradiance: IAU 2015 B3 nominal L_sun 3.828e26 W over 4 pi a^2 = 178.0 W m^-2 at r = a; point-source Sun
provenance.spin: MEASURED: sidereal rotation 9.074170 h = 32667.012 s (Dawn; Wikipedia infobox 9.074169392 h); prograde; obliquity 3.997 deg rounded to 4.0 (Ermakov et al. 2017, via Wikipedia); subsolar longitude 0 at perihelion is an ASSUMPTION
provenance.forcing_period: DERIVED: mean solar day 1/P_sol = 1/P_rot - 1/P_orb = 32674.367 s (4442.38 rotations per orbit). Used as cycle_s. Not an exact recurrence of the geometry: with e = 0.0791 and 4 deg obliquity successive solar days differ slightly (ASSUMPTION that cycle-to-cycle drift stays within the periodicity thresholds)
provenance.albedo: MEASURED: Bond albedo 0.037 +/- 0.002 at 555 nm, Li et al. 2019 (arXiv:1812.08361), Dawn FC
provenance.emissivity: ASSUMED 0.90 (common airless-regolith value; not a Ceres measurement)
provenance.geothermal_flux: ASSUMED 0 (Ceres radiogenic flux is a few mW m^-2, negligible for a diurnal column)
provenance.material: INFERRED/ASSUMED: single stratum, constant k, rho, c_p, no radiative (T^3) conductivity term; TI 15 is the low end of the global Dawn VIR range, chosen for the bland equatorial regolith away from Haulani/Occator anomalies
provenance.geography: smooth sphere, flat surface, uniform material, no topography or shadowing; radius 469.7 km (Dawn, Park et al. 2016)
provenance.initial_temperature: ASSUMED 160 K (near expected diurnal mean at the equator)
